points.quote: Rust rules out use-after-free and data races at compile time through ownership
points.problem: 'Data races' and 'ownership' are never explained earlier in the book; a newcomer cannot tell what is being ruled out or how. The same unexplained 'ownership rules' appears in the Fig 5.7 strip.
points.hint: Gloss each in half a clause, or drop 'data races' and 'through ownership'.
